contracts: The current complete migration test module passes, all five native strict package checks pass and frozen owner/authority boundaries remain intact.

intents.expected_result: Repair a genuine host admission defect narrowly with positive and negative tests before final input freezing, without weakening failure oracles.
intents.observable: Tool corrections preserve the actual bound failure and validation gates.

intents.expected_result: Do not change Phase, BMAD/GDS, Chapter 2-7, accepted Package A authority, device configuration, existing budgets/security permissions or historical receipts to make this migration pass.
intents.observable: Protected source identities and runtime boundaries remain outside the migration patch.

intents.expected_result: Retain all six requests with explicit test/case coverage in the complete plan.
intents.observable: No retained request disappears from observable verification.

intents.expected_result: Run all five strict Package A public checks, relevant owning-package regressions and a route-boundary check.
intents.observable: The migration has actual public validation and relevant regressions rather than a sidecar-only claim.

intents.expected_result: Add strict-valid Bootstrap quality declarations and clean/later-round/access-failure examples without a replacement review framework.
intents.observable: The actual Bootstrap package passes strict validation with all declared route outcomes.

intents.expected_result: Prepare Package-B-only requirements with stable FR anchors and source-role/hash mapping, including shared constraints but excluding Package A implementation and unrelated BMAD artifacts.
intents.observable: The canonical input and mapping retain all current requirements with explicit source identity.

intents.expected_result: Add a strict-valid VDD quality sidecar with dependencies and primary create/direct-input/invalid-input examples.
intents.observable: The actual VDD package passes the existing strict public validator with all three route families declared.

intents.expected_result: Reuse native originals only when content, coverage and environment match, not because of summaries or Git SHA alone.
intents.observable: Valid current evidence is referenced and incompatible originals do not silently pass.

intents.expected_result: A sidecar or passing quality validator grants no workflow or publication power.
intents.observable: Quality declaration authorizes no action and existing owners still decide execution.

intents.expected_result: Provide concise dependency tables for the governed packages.
intents.observable: Prerequisites and their existing owner remain explicit without deleting legitimate dependencies.

intents.expected_result: Do not treat absent imports, files or test runtimes as behavioral RED.
intents.observable: Harness/setup failures cannot authorize production implementation.

intents.expected_result: Limit the migration to repository-local Skill package contracts, examples, routing, dependencies, validation, tests, references and safety declarations.
intents.observable: No unrelated runtime or application feature is introduced.

intents.expected_result: When operational details need to leave a main file, move them to directly linked first-level references.
intents.observable: Moved details remain directly reachable rather than hidden behind unresolved or deep reference chains.

intents.expected_result: Read the package requirements and repository authority routed by AGENTS.md before planning.
intents.observable: Planning is grounded in current required sources and owning contracts.

intents.expected_result: Keep upgrade classification at the owning VDD boundary without automatic approval or BMAD fallback, and preserve exact cases, failure IDs, write scopes and per-unit budgets.
intents.observable: Existing controlled proof and escalation requirements remain intact.

intents.expected_result: Leave all BMAD and GDS Skill implementations outside the migration write scope.
intents.observable: No BMAD or GDS package is modified by Package B implementation.

intents.expected_result: Retain legitimate child Skill dependencies while documenting independent invocation.
intents.observable: Standalone does not become a false dependency-free claim or permission to remove required child checks.

intents.expected_result: Add quality declarations and focused checks without replacing current public workflows, gates, errors, caller-session transport or content-bound reuse.
intents.observable: The migration retains existing runtime owners and does not treat historical passes as current verification.

intents.expected_result: Keep directly affected existing tests green and verify routing has no authority, lifecycle, security or compatibility regression.
intents.observable: Focused package and boundary checks pass without unrelated full-workflow expansion.

intents.expected_result: Declare actual prerequisites, authority/version and missing/mismatch outcomes using the adopted package-local JSON id/version contract when required.
intents.observable: The existing dependency validator can resolve real local records and rejects mismatches or missing required prerequisites.

intents.expected_result: Retain the verified Acceptance maintenance-route prerequisite for catalog-stale-maintenance.
intents.observable: Removing an operator-only mismatch does not relax the separate stale-maintenance route.

intents.expected_result: Use owning plan predicates and current terminal validation to determine completion, never assistant text, document status or a child summary.
intents.observable: Plan-ready and implementation/Acceptance completion are not inferred from advisory text.

intents.expected_result: Document operator-requested with a real target, pinned main and actual maintainer confirmation, without imposing a stale-route artifact.
intents.observable: The documented route agrees with the current native helper and cannot fabricate authority.

intents.expected_result: Keep formal inputs, code, plans and native evidence in the original repository; save content-hashed stage snapshots, verify restoration and retain an authorized durable copy outside ephemeral storage.
intents.observable: New work has explicit source/evidence identities and verified recovery data rather than a sole temporary directory.

intents.expected_result: Do not acquire automatic commit, release, deployment, archive or protected-path approval authority through the migration.
intents.observable: Quality declarations and planning outputs remain non-authorizing.

intents.expected_result: Freeze package-specific sources, dependencies, production write/read boundaries and acceptance commands before implementation.
intents.observable: Each required frozen input category remains explicit, content-bound and available to the consumer.

intents.expected_result: Freeze common inputs before final proof and retain failed evidence as immutable history.
intents.observable: Current proof binds final bytes while failures are not overwritten or upgraded.

intents.expected_result: Preserve action registry, authority, current-proof and finalization requirements; Q8 alone is not acceptance-passed.
intents.observable: Acceptance metadata retains the separate finalization and proof gates.

intents.expected_result: Keep RED execution and future execution proof out of VDD output.
intents.observable: VDD supplies intent, not fabricated runtime receipts or readiness of later phases.

intents.expected_result: Use the existing deterministic validator and add or extend focused migration tests.
intents.observable: Actual package-quality transitions and relevant regressions are tested rather than inferred from declarations.

intents.expected_result: Use the public VDD compiler and self-hosted plan shape for this control-plane migration; native workers and gates alone own plan-ready.
intents.observable: No hand-authored plan state substitutes for the real compiler.

intents.expected_result: Provide strict-plan handoff, upgrade classification and invalid-contract examples using the existing Quick Dev owner boundary.
intents.observable: The three examples distinguish lawful handoff, escalation/classification and rejection without implying automatic upgrade permission.

intents.expected_result: Use the accepted standard, existing public strict/inventory validator, policy and schemas without a second validator or oracle change.
intents.observable: The adopted authority remains unchanged and is the validator used by migration checks.

intents.expected_result: Consume the accepted Package A standard as the prerequisite for Package B and downstream implementation. Stop dependent scope when a prerequisite is blocked, unaccepted or stale.
intents.observable: The accepted predecessor is reused and a blocked predecessor cannot silently authorize dependent implementation.

intents.expected_result: Provide clean review, later-round confirmation and failed access/preflight examples.
intents.observable: The three examples preserve the different Bootstrap preflight/round outcomes.

intents.expected_result: Do not add a global runtime enforcement platform, daemon, database, MCP service, new model policy, blanket external-version gate or approval system.
intents.observable: The migration remains package-local and reuses the current control plane.

intents.expected_result: Reuse substantive existing declarations and operational references; add a separate guide only when details need to leave the main file.
intents.observable: Details remain reachable without five replacement documentation/control frameworks.

intents.expected_result: Use the least sufficient VDD profile; control-plane Skill or validator changes normally use self-hosted.
intents.observable: The selected profile is explicit and justified for this control-plane migration.

intents.expected_result: Preserve under-500-line main files, typed dependency failures and capability-aware controls.
intents.observable: The adopted validator and negative fixtures retain these observable boundaries.

intents.expected_result: Add strict-valid Acceptance declarations and deterministic, repair and manual-or-stale examples.
intents.observable: The actual Acceptance package passes strict validation with distinct native outcomes.

intents.expected_result: Use supported actual local test dependencies and do not relabel Linux results as Windows execution.
intents.observable: Reported platforms and prerequisite availability match actual runs.

intents.expected_result: Create or repair a complete VDD plan only for the maintainer explicit complete-plan request.
intents.observable: Standalone direct implementation does not silently create a plan directory.

intents.expected_result: Use controlled Quick Dev probes; present behavior receives current regression/terminal and missing behavior requires bound RED before Q4 and GREEN/REFACTOR.
intents.observable: Existing behavior is not forced to fail and missing behavior has real causal TDD proof.

intents.expected_result: Preserve main-bound source ownership, failed sidecars, last-known-good and explicit publication; do not hard-code an obsolete suite count.
intents.observable: Current instructions keep real publisher ownership and refer to the registered suite rather than an obsolete numeric count.

intents.expected_result: Use the existing skill-quality.v1.json sidecar contract and retain only name and description in frontmatter.
intents.observable: The declared quality contract is valid without unsupported frontmatter fields.

intents.expected_result: Provide deterministic Acceptance, repair and manual-pause-or-stale-input examples.
intents.observable: The three examples distinguish native finalization, bounded repair and blocked/manual handling.

intents.expected_result: Preserve Phase browser/API, live runtime, Caddy, live metadata, Hosted workspaces, authentication and shared LLM entrypoint behavior.
intents.observable: The migration does not alter any of these protected application/runtime behaviors.

intents.expected_result: Provide existing-only refresh, targeted provisional result and publication/authority failure examples.
intents.observable: The examples do not promote provisional results or failed authority checks into publication.

intents.expected_result: Preserve lifecycle ownership, fail-closed behavior, evidence rules and protected boundaries during migration.
intents.observable: No quality declaration or passing check expands these existing authorities.

intents.expected_result: Provide materially distinct VDD create, standalone direct-implementation boundary and invalid-input examples with their actual inputs and typed outputs.
intents.observable: All three VDD route examples are available and do not promote direct input or invalid input into plan readiness.

intents.expected_result: Make public entries independently invocable with explicit preflight and typed missing-dependency behavior.
intents.observable: Each declared public entry can report its own real prerequisites and missing outcome without undocumented caller setup.

intents.expected_result: Keep every governed SKILL.md strictly below 500 logical lines.
intents.observable: The adopted validator rejects a 500-line main file and accepts an otherwise compliant 499-line fixture.

intents.expected_result: Never resolve drift by editing historical evidence, weakening a validator or silently applying a new Skill contract to an old frozen plan.
intents.observable: Old evidence remains bound to its actual source and verification rules.

intents.expected_result: Add strict-valid knowledge-maintenance declarations and existing-only, targeted-provisional and publication/authority-failure examples.
intents.observable: The actual maintenance package passes strict validation without promoting provisional output.

intents.expected_result: Provide typed standard error outputs for the package public boundaries.
intents.observable: Invalid inputs and missing prerequisites have distinct documented outputs rather than apparent success.

intents.expected_result: Do not automatically publish/merge GitHub changes or run unrelated full Windows workflows as part of the cloud implementation.
intents.observable: Reported work stays within the authorized cloud stages and records actual platform limits.

intents.expected_result: Stop and repair when security capability classification or required confirmation changes.
intents.observable: A new security posture does not reuse old permission or evidence.

intents.expected_result: Leave workflow-chapter2-repository-bootstrap through workflow-chapter7-ui-wiring-closure outside the migration write scope.
intents.observable: No excluded Chapter 2-7 package implementation is changed.

intents.expected_result: Stop and repair when a lifecycle owner or authorizes boundary changes.
intents.observable: No lifecycle or authorization transfer occurs through silent migration.

intents.expected_result: Add strict-valid Quick Dev metadata with strict-plan, upgrade-boundary and invalid-contract examples.
intents.observable: The actual Quick Dev package passes strict quality validation with these distinct routes.

intents.expected_result: Stop and repair when a current child Skill public entry or output contract changes.
intents.observable: The consumer must resolve real changed dependency contracts before proceeding.

intents.expected_result: Treat native implementation-complete only as Quick Dev completion; perform the requested independent A/B and necessary repair before the separate final Acceptance workflow.
intents.observable: A Q8/sidecar result does not claim external review approval or acceptance-passed.

intents.expected_result: Replace machine-specific validation commands with actual repository-owned checks.
intents.observable: Bootstrap Skill validation instructions do not depend on one machine private Skill path.

intents.expected_result: Provide an ASCII decision tree or flow only for a package with internal routing/orchestration.
intents.observable: A routing package has an actionable diagram, while simple operations are not forced into invented routing.

intents.expected_result: Do not reconstruct the missing old candidate by copying old success states.
intents.observable: Fresh implementation and native proof remain distinguishable from historical investigation clues.

intents.expected_result: Treat Package A implementation as the accepted prerequisite, not additional Package B implementation scope.
intents.observable: Package B requirements and repair do not reopen accepted Package A work.

intents.expected_result: Preserve atomic source/contract coverage, native repair and separation of plan-ready, implementation and Acceptance.
intents.observable: VDD metadata cannot bypass native semantic gates or claim later lifecycle states.

intents.expected_result: Stop and use a repair/successor path if an accepted standard, ADR, schema, validator, command or dependency hash changes.
intents.observable: Changed accepted inputs are not silently reused as the old frozen execution contract.

intents.expected_result: Express existing source files as real file paths, functions as separate prose and directory annotations as directories.
intents.observable: The public source reader can resolve actual required inputs without dropping sources or mistaking directories/function suffixes for filenames.

intents.expected_result: Require all five migrated packages to pass the existing strict validator.
intents.observable: The actual adopted validator passes each current target package.

intents.expected_result: Treat a local declaration record as an adopted contract version, not installation or approval evidence; keep actual native runtime checks and legitimate child dependencies.
intents.observable: Metadata neither pretends that tools/models/publication are installed nor makes independent entry invocation dependency-free.

intents.expected_result: Preserve generated historical evidence and failed run bytes; append actual new evidence rather than rewriting historical runs.
intents.observable: Prior evidence retains its original content identity and is not upgraded into current success.

intents.expected_result: Do not modify BMAD wrappers, official installation, administrator consumer registration or local forwarding in Package B; keep device configuration and paths ignored.
intents.observable: Separate committed BMAD capabilities and private deployment data remain outside migration writes.

intents.expected_result: Retain 1800-second total and 600-second genuine inactivity limits for each independent unit, with bounded cumulative retry cost.
intents.observable: Heartbeats, retries or new workers cannot reset total cost or renew a stalled unit.

intents.expected_result: Stop and repair when the declared write set, execution read set or target containment changes.
intents.observable: A changed execution boundary does not inherit old completion proof.

intents.expected_result: Inspect current five packages, actual callers and focused tests and distinguish existing behavior from missing quality metadata or stale prose.
intents.observable: Migration decisions retain current code facts instead of assuming a status check proves implementation.

intents.expected_result: Preserve later-round and consumer authority and do not automatically launch an extra reviewer during this migration.
intents.observable: Quality maintenance grants no new review, launch or round authority.
